test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"The director should announce the results today.

options.text: The results should be announced today.
The results should be announce today.
The results should have been announced.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The director should announce the results today."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the results" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "should announce" to "should be announced" (modal + be + past participle).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "today" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The results should be announced today."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The results should being announced." – Incorrect use of "being" instead of "be."
 
• **Option 3: **"The results should be announce today." – Incorrect verb form ("announce" instead of "announced").
 
• **Option 4: **"The results should have been announced." – Incorrect tense (past modal passive).
